name: ledger_transfer
description: A pure ledger transfer transition. The state contains two unsigned 64-bit balances and the last successful request identifier. A request is authorized only for actor 0, must carry a strictly newer request identifier and a positive amount, and succeeds only when the debit balance covers the amount and the credit balance remains within the unsigned 64-bit maximum. A successful transition transfers exactly the amount from debit to credit and records the request identifier. Every other request is rejected and returns the complete prior state unchanged. The strict-newer rule makes a retry of a successfully recorded request an identity transition, and all arithmetic is expressed in mathematical Nat values bounded by the u64 input range.
specification: if actor = 0 ∧ amount > 0 ∧ request_id > s.last_successful_request_id ∧ s.debit_balance ≥ amount ∧ s.credit_balance + amount ≤ 18446744073709551615 then { debit_balance := s.debit_balance - amount, credit_balance := s.credit_balance + amount, last_successful_request_id := request_id } else { debit_balance := s.debit_balance, credit_balance := s.credit_balance, last_successful_request_id := s.last_successful_request_id }

properties.name: total_balance_preserved
properties.description: The sum of the debit and credit balances is unchanged by every transition.

properties.name: rejection_preserves_state
properties.description: Every request that is not authorized, strictly newer, positive, fully debited, and credit-safe is rejected without changing any state field.
properties.statement: ¬(actor = 0 ∧ amount > 0 ∧ request_id > s.last_successful_request_id ∧ s.debit_balance ≥ amount ∧ s.credit_balance + amount ≤ 18446744073709551615) → (out.debit_balance = s.debit_balance ∧ out.credit_balance = s.credit_balance ∧ out.last_successful_request_id = s.last_successful_request_id)

properties.name: accepted_transfer_is_exact
properties.description: An authorized, strictly newer, positive request transfers exactly its amount and records its identifier.
properties.statement: (actor = 0 ∧ amount > 0 ∧ request_id > s.last_successful_request_id ∧ s.debit_balance ≥ amount ∧ s.credit_balance + amount ≤ 18446744073709551615) → (out.debit_balance = s.debit_balance - amount ∧ out.credit_balance = s.credit_balance + amount ∧ out.last_successful_request_id = request_id)

properties.name: unauthorized_actor_rejected
properties.description: Any actor other than actor 0 is rejected and leaves the state unchanged.
properties.statement: actor ≠ 0 → (out.debit_balance = s.debit_balance ∧ out.credit_balance = s.credit_balance ∧ out.last_successful_request_id = s.last_successful_request_id)

properties.name: zero_amount_rejected
properties.description: A zero amount is rejected and leaves the state unchanged.
properties.statement: amount = 0 → (out.debit_balance = s.debit_balance ∧ out.credit_balance = s.credit_balance ∧ out.last_successful_request_id = s.last_successful_request_id)

properties.name: insufficient_debit_rejected
properties.description: A request whose amount exceeds the debit balance is rejected and leaves the state unchanged.
properties.statement: s.debit_balance < amount → (out.debit_balance = s.debit_balance ∧ out.credit_balance = s.credit_balance ∧ out.last_successful_request_id = s.last_successful_request_id)

properties.name: credit_overflow_rejected
properties.description: A request that would make the credit balance exceed the unsigned 64-bit maximum is rejected and leaves the state unchanged.
properties.statement: s.credit_balance + amount > 18446744073709551615 → (out.debit_balance = s.debit_balance ∧ out.credit_balance = s.credit_balance ∧ out.last_successful_request_id = s.last_successful_request_id)

properties.name: old_or_repeated_id_rejected
properties.description: An old or repeated request identifier is rejected and leaves the state unchanged; this is the idempotence rule for retries.
properties.statement: request_id ≤ s.last_successful_request_id → (out.debit_balance = s.debit_balance ∧ out.credit_balance = s.credit_balance ∧ out.last_successful_request_id = s.last_successful_request_id)
